evidence.title: Alibaba Cloud launches its first cloud region in Brazil

summary: Alibaba Cloud, the cloud computing arm of Alibaba Group, announced the launch of its first dedicated cloud region in Brazil, marking its entry into the South American market. The new region will offer local data residency, reduced latency, and a full suite of cloud services to Brazilian businesses and developers.
title: Alibaba Cloud Opens First Brazil Region, Expanding Its Global Infrastructure
